name: Camera Effects
author: alanfortlink
description: System-wide camera and microphone effects (Center Stage, Portrait, Studio Light, Backgrounds, Filters, Fun face filters, Reactions, Block camera; Voice Isolation, noise gate, auto level, tone, voice changer, reverb, mute) exposed as the "Camera Effects" virtual webcam and the "Microphone Effects" virtual microphone, with a Control-Center-style panel in the bar.

barWidget.description: Camera and microphone effects panel with live preview; the icon lights up while an app is using the camera.

schema.label: Show icon even when no app is using the camera
